fields.name: navigator_line_of_authority
fields.category: license types and scope of service
fields.description: The specific line of authority granted under a navigator license, distinguishing full navigator authority from the more limited certified application counselor authority.
fields.sample_quote: A license type under this chapter shall be a navigator line of authority or a certified application counselor line of authority.

fields.name: scope_limited_to_exchange_plans
fields.category: license types and scope of service
fields.description: Whether the navigator's authorized activities are restricted to plans and programs offered on a health benefit exchange, prohibiting assistance with off-exchange products.
fields.sample_quote: may perform, offer to perform, or advertise a service as a navigator only for a person selecting a qualified health plan or public program offered on an exchange; and may not perform, offer to perform, or advertise services as a navigator for individuals or small employer groups selecting accident and health insurance plans, qualified health plans, public programs, business, or services that are not offered on an exchange

fields.name: plan_recommendation_prohibited
fields.category: license types and scope of service
fields.description: Whether the navigator is explicitly prohibited from recommending a particular health plan to a consumer.
fields.sample_quote: may not recommend a particular accident and health insurance plan or qualified health plan

fields.name: insurance_sales_prohibited
fields.category: license types and scope of service
fields.description: Whether the navigator is explicitly prohibited from selling insurance.
fields.sample_quote: does not sell insurance

fields.name: public_programs_covered
fields.category: license types and scope of service
fields.description: The public health programs (e.g., Medicaid, CHIP) that navigators are authorized to assist consumers in enrolling in.
fields.sample_quote: "Public programs" means the state Medicaid program in Title 26B, Chapter 3, Health Care - Administration and Assistance, and Title 26B, Chapter 3, Part 9, Utah Children's Health Insurance Program.

fields.name: premium_subsidy_assistance_authorized
fields.category: license types and scope of service
fields.description: Whether the navigator is authorized to assist consumers with applying for premium subsidies through the exchange.
fields.sample_quote: applying for premium subsidies through an exchange

fields.name: federal_grant_or_certification_required
fields.category: how navigators are authorized and overseen
fields.description: Whether the navigator must have received a grant from and been certified by the health benefit exchange established under the ACA as a condition of operating.
fields.sample_quote: any person who has received a grant from and has been certified by the health benefit exchange established pursuant to section 1311 of the affordable care act, 42 U.S.C. § 18031, to act as a navigator

fields.name: federal_training_completion_required
fields.category: how navigators are authorized and overseen
fields.description: Whether the navigator must complete the training program required by the health benefit exchange (including CMS-developed programs) as a condition of licensure.
fields.sample_quote: has completed the training required by the health benefit exchange

fields.name: cms_training_program_required
fields.category: how navigators are authorized and overseen
fields.description: Whether the navigator's pre-license training must specifically include the training and certification program developed by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.
fields.sample_quote: the training required by Subsection (1) shall consist of at least 21 credit hours of training before obtaining the license, which shall include the navigator training and certification program developed by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services

fields.name: pre_license_training_hours
fields.category: how navigators are authorized and overseen
fields.description: Minimum number of training credit hours required before obtaining a navigator license (for the full navigator line of authority).
fields.sample_quote: the training required by Subsection (1) shall consist of at least 21 credit hours of training before obtaining the license

fields.name: conflict_of_interest_standards_required
fields.category: how navigators are authorized and overseen
fields.description: Whether the navigator must comply with conflict-of-interest standards established by federal PPACA regulations, including as part of training and character requirements.
fields.sample_quote: the applicant does not have a conflict of interest as defined by regulations issued under PPACA

fields.name: compensation_source_restrictions
fields.category: compensation and financial rules
fields.description: Entities from which a navigator is prohibited from receiving direct or indirect compensation for navigator services.
fields.sample_quote: does not receive any compensation for acting as a navigator directly or indirectly from an insured, insurance producer, or an insurer

fields.name: exchange_compensation_permitted
fields.category: compensation and financial rules
fields.description: Whether the navigator may be compensated by the exchange itself for performing navigator duties.
fields.sample_quote: may be compensated by the exchange for performing the duties of a navigator

fields.name: surety_bond_required
fields.category: compensation and financial rules
fields.description: Whether the navigator is required to obtain and maintain a surety bond to cover legal liability arising from erroneous acts or failures to act.
fields.sample_quote: a navigator shall obtain a surety bond in an amount designated by the commissioner by administrative rule to cover the legal liability of the navigator as the result of an erroneous act or failure to act in the navigator's capacity as a navigator

fields.name: fiduciary_funds_prohibited
fields.category: compensation and financial rules
fields.description: Whether the navigator is explicitly prohibited from receiving, collecting, or holding funds that would constitute fiduciary funds under insurance law.
fields.sample_quote: A person who has received a grant from and has been certified by the health benefit exchange ... shall not receive, collect or hold any funds that would constitute fiduciary funds within the meaning of section two thousand one hundred twenty of this article.

fields.name: agency_license_available
fields.category: individual and agency licensing structure
fields.description: Whether a navigator agency (organizational) license is available in addition to individual navigator licenses.
fields.sample_quote: An organization shall be licensed as a navigator agency if the organization acts as a navigator.

fields.name: designated_responsible_individual_required
fields.category: individual and agency licensing structure
fields.description: Whether a navigator agency must designate a specific licensed individual responsible for the agency's compliance with navigator laws and regulations.
fields.sample_quote: A navigator agency that does business in the state shall designate an individual who is licensed under this chapter to act on the agency's behalf.

fields.name: license_term_years
fields.category: individual and agency licensing structure
fields.description: Duration in years of a navigator license before renewal is required.
fields.sample_quote: A license issued under this chapter is valid for one year.

fields.name: licensing_exemptions
fields.category: who does not need a navigator license
fields.description: Categories of persons or entities explicitly exempt from the navigator licensing requirement.
fields.sample_quote: The commissioner may not require a license as a navigator of: a person who is employed by or contracts with a health care facility ... to assist an individual with enrollment in a public program or an application for premium subsidy; a federally qualified health center ... an Indian health clinic or Urban Indian Health Center

fields.name: cultural_and_linguistic_competence_training_required
fields.category: training content requirements
fields.description: Whether navigator training must include cultural and linguistic competence as a required topic.
fields.sample_quote: The training required by Subsection (1) shall be approved by the commissioner and shall include: ... cultural and linguistic competence

fields.name: continuing_education_ethics_hours_required
fields.category: training content requirements
fields.description: Minimum number of continuing education hours per renewal period that must be dedicated to ethics courses.
fields.sample_quote: that at least two of the 12 credit hours described in Subsection (3)(a)(i) be ethics courses

fields.name: annual_cms_recertification_required
fields.category: training content requirements
fields.description: Whether navigators must complete the annual CMS navigator or certified application counselor training and certification program as part of continuing education each license period.
fields.sample_quote: that a licensee complete the annual navigator training and certification program developed by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
